findings.layout: No visible horizontal overflow, text collision, obscured controls, accidental clipping within content, or broken column flow in the reviewed regions. Top/bottom viewport cuts are normal scrolling boundaries.
findings.bilingual_alignment: Corresponding expanded translation blocks align by paragraph/response. Documentary source-only appendix occupies the Hebrew column; blank English column preserves the absent English witness.
findings.missing_translation_handling: Hebrew-only expanded additions use full width; documentary Hebrew-only additions retain the source column. No fabricated English is visible.
findings.instruction_description_styles: Rust-colored role/rubric/instruction text is distinct from black recitation text. Centered day/section headings and editorial descriptions separate blocks. The source English insertion instruction remains visibly an instruction within its source witness.
findings.duplicates_and_gaps: No accidental visual duplicate or unexplained internal gap found. Cantor/priest repeated words are explicitly labeled. Multiple expanded day alternatives are visibly headed and are not treated as duplicate recitations in an unresolved reader state.
findings.navigation_and_optional_controls: Supplied browser report passes duplicate IDs, missing local targets and horizontal overflow for all3 exports; commentary links for leaves339/340 exist, and optional ואיים omission is reflected in visible text. Contents/Settings controls are visible and unobscured in all screenshots.
findings.citations_and_pages: Supplied compiled proof preserves prior106-note prefix, adds8notes for114total, and records exactly one marker for each closing IA leaf345–354 (scans346–355). This proof is read as supplied, not generalized into an independent comparison of every output.
findings.english_preservation: Supplied exact comparison reports50930 old/new English words with no differences; source-only appendix visuals are consistent with that preservation.

limitations: Review covers12 desktop screenshots at1280×1000, not every scroll position or mobile viewport.
Images named response capture the livelihood-to-daily transition rather than the earlier cue/response sequence; the expanded priestly image does show the first cue/response rows.
Image named expanded preparation shows tikkun/offering paragraphs, not the Retzeh preparation alternatives.

Expanded daily image shows several day alternatives with Set the place unset. Calendar/date filtering and other seasonal states are outside this visual approval and require the separate runtime evidence.
A screenshot cannot verify all local links or optional controls; those claims rely on the supplied browser report.
Source text was not re-OCRed or re-adjudicated. Existing source/semantic module approvals are unchanged.
PDFs, pagination, running headers, footnotes in print, final full-batch acceptance and export publication are excluded.
